title: *Sudan's National Adaptation Plan*
organization: Government of Sudan / HCENR, hosted by UNFCCC
geographic_coverage: National; state components for all 18 states
methodology: State consultation, vulnerability assessment, station data, CMIP5 GCMs and BCSD downscaling
limitations: Pre-war; CMIP5; six-station baseline; not an evaluation. (UNFCCC1)

title: *Sudan Updated First NDC*
methodology: Government synthesis of vulnerability, adaptation priorities and implementation needs
limitations: Predates current war; some national trend statements are not readily reconcilable with the NAP station record; programme/self-report evidence. (UNFCCC2)

title: *Sudan's NAP: Key adaptation priorities & financial needs*
methodology: Policy presentation summarizing priorities, finance and support needs
limitations: Not an independent implementation review; primarily restates national plans and financing needs. (UNFCCC6)

title: *Climate-Fragility Risk Brief: Sudan*
limitations: Pre-war political/security setting; secondary synthesis rather than causal evaluation. (Climate-Diplomacy7)

title: *Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Sudan*
limitations: Predates April 2023 war; some institutional recommendations refer to arrangements that later changed. (NUPI8)

title: *How does climate exacerbate root causes of conflict in Sudan? Climate Security Pathway Analysis*
geographic_coverage: Sudan; emphasis on Darfur, Kordofan, Blue Nile, Kassala
methodology: Systematic literature interpretation plus stakeholder workshop
limitations: Completed around onset of current war; mechanisms include workshop judgement and older studies; not causal impact evaluation. (CGSpace9)

title: *Climate Change, Conflicts and Food Security in North Darfur State, Sudan: Risks and Implications*
methodology: Al Fashir station data; RAI; crop-yield analysis; internet-based IDP household questionnaire
limitations: Single-state study; only Al Fashir station used for drought analysis; internet survey during conflict/siege; no national inference warranted. (CMI - Chr. Michelsen Institute10)

title: *Famine Review Committee: Sudan, October 2025 - Conclusions and Recommendations*
geographic_coverage: El Fasher, Kadugli, Dilling, Western Nuba Mountains and wider risk areas
methodology: FRC review, multiple outcome datasets, extrapolation, key informants and expert judgement under access constraints
limitations: Severe access/data constraints; FRC explicitly declined longer projection in some areas because conflict was too volatile. (IPCinfo5)

title: *Three years on, war-weary Sudanese remain on the move*
limitations: Fast-changing operational figures; not a climate-attribution source. (UNHCR3)

title: *Terminal Evaluation Report: Climate Risk Finance for Sustainable and Climate Resilient Rainfed Farming and Pastoral Systems, Sudan*
geographic_coverage: Six states: River Nile, North Kordofan, Gedarif, South Darfur, Kassala, White Nile
methodology: UNDP/GEF evaluation criteria; documents, interviews and limited field evidence
limitations: Pre-war; commissioned within UNDP/GEF evaluation system; some respondents/financial records unavailable; COVID reduced field sample. (UNDP IEO Evaluation Resource Center11)

title: *Environmental degradation and conflict in Darfur: implications for peace and recovery*
organization: Humanitarian Practice Network / ODI; author Brendan Bromwich, UNEP
limitations: Foundational but old; environmental scarcity is broader than anthropogenic climate change; Darfur-specific. (Humanitarian Practice Network12)

title: *Sudan - Enhancing Community Resilience Project (P181490), Additional Financing 3 Project Paper*
geographic_coverage: Kassala, Northern, River Nile and other project locations
methodology: Project monitoring, implementation ratings, risk analysis and results framework
limitations: Administrative project evidence, not independent impact evaluation; targets are not achieved outcomes. (World Bank13)

title: *New FAO-WFP report warns worsening hunger puts 13 hotspots at significant risk*
geographic_coverage: National with North/South Darfur and South Kordofan hotspots
temporal_coverage: Jun-Nov 2026; some Sudan projections to Jan 2027
methodology: GNAFC consensus early warning using field/technical teams and conflict, economic and natural-hazard analysts
limitations: Forward-looking; not designed to isolate climate effects from conflict; report PDF access was blocked by the browser, but publication/release content was accessible. (World Food Programme14)

title: *Risk of Famine persists as nearly 19.5 million people face acute food insecurity in Sudan*
limitations: Humanitarian operational source; rapidly changing; no climate attribution. (World Food Programme15)
